title: Payment Standing and the Assisted Living Apartment Transfer Fee
content:
Payment standing raises the apartment transfer fee under the Assisted Living Residency and Care Agreement. It is counted by the late fees posted on the residency in the 12 whole months before the handling date.

| Late fees posted in the window | Share of the transfer fee |
|---|---|
| Two or more | 1.2 |
| Exactly one | 1.1 |
| None | Unchanged |

The share multiplies the transfer fee before it is rounded once to the cent.

**The window.** A late fee counts when fewer than 12 whole months separate its posting date from the handling date, a whole month being completed each time the count reaches the same day of the month as the posting date: with a hypothetical handling date of 20 May 2026, a late fee posted on 21 May 2025 counts and one posted on 20 May 2025 does not.

**Illustration (hypothetical).** On a fee of 650.00 alone, one late fee in the window gives 715.00 and two give 780.00.
